doc.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: New pots and pans and keeping the recipes simple
summary: Light exchange about needing new pans and keeping the show's recipes simple, with side musicians as side dishes.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: So on the lighter side, did you have to buy new pots and pans for your —

You know Brian said to me yesterday, he said, “You know if you continue with this you really need new pans.” I mean I’m looking at them and they’re really old and you know and I’m trying not to show some of the baking trays that have, I mean who goes out and buys baking trays? We make do, right? You make do with everything now.
I think it makes it more, “You can do this at home too.”

Yeah I know. I know. Yeah. Exactly. I did want to focus some of the recipes on that. The second one is four ingredients. The next one is — they’re pretty simple I guess. Like the last one, the one last night, what was it, chicken schnitzel — you don’t have to do the salad, you know what I mean? You can kind of just do what you want with it you know. But —
You can plug in the side people.
Yeah, exactly. You can choose your side musicians.
